item.tib: mnyam med bla ma'i nang sgrub kyi cha rkyen rdzogs chen snying po bar do'i dus kyi ngo sprod gsal ba'i sgron me
item.coloph: zhes mdo smad skam rigs kyi rgad po 'u thug mgo dkar ba drung mu nyi wer bdag gis/ mnyam med bla ma'i nang sgrub kyi cha rkyen du sbyar ba la/ 'gal 'khrul nor gsum gang mchis bar do'i 'khrul pa rang snang rtogs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du bzod cing*/ dge ba gang mchis sems can tha mal pa rnams kyi don du bsngo ba dang / bkra shis kyi dge mtshan mnyam med bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
